scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.dev: cd artifacts/portfolio && PORT=5173 BASE_PATH=/ API_PORT=5000 pnpm run dev
scripts.server: cd artifacts/api-server && bash -c 'set -a; source .env.local || exit 1; set +a; PORT=5000 pnpm run dev'
